adjudicator_run.prompt_text: Review the packet evidence and the two already frozen primary AI decisions. Resolve only genuine protocol-family or primary-root-cause disagreement, explain the evidence basis, preserve uncertainty, and return high, medium, or low confidence. Do not treat model agreement as proof of truth.

agreement_rules.consensus: Both frozen primary decisions match on protocol_family and primary_root_cause.
agreement_rules.disagreement: A distinct frozen adjudicator model/run resolves the disagreement after both primary decisions are frozen.

limitations: AI outputs are not human adjudications and cannot increment the independent-human-adjudication counter.
Model diversity does not establish institutional, disciplinary, or real-world reviewer independence.
Agreement can reflect shared training data, shared blind spots, prompt anchoring, or correlated model error.
Internal progression does not establish external release, publication readiness, or venue compliance.
The protocol and limitation must be disclosed in any external manuscript or submission package.

primary_runs.prompt_text: Using only the supplied packet evidence and reviewer codebook, return one protocol family and one primary root cause, a concise evidence-bound rationale, evidence references, and high, medium, or low confidence. Do not infer from another model, detector prediction, final benchmark label, or post-incident model output. Preserve unknown when evidence is inadequate.

sensitivity_requirements: report all-case agreement and chance-corrected reliability

sensitivity_run.prompt_text: Independently regenerate the classification using only the supplied packet. First identify the earliest evidenced causal failure and distinguish it from downstream exploit actions; then return one protocol family, one primary root cause, rationale, evidence references, and confidence. Preserve UNKNOWN_INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE when the packet cannot support a label.
